meta.name: customer-research
meta.description: Mine online communities and analyze existing assets to understand what customers actually think, say, and struggle with. Use when the user wants to do customer research, ICP research, voice-of-customer (VOC), review mining, Reddit mining, YouTube comment analysis, G2/Capterra scraping, build customer personas, map jobs to be done, understand churn reasons, or find authentic customer language for copy. Also use when given transcripts, surveys, or support tickets to synthesize.

copy.tagline: 挖掘在线社区和评论，提炼客户真实想法与痛点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想从海量用户评论和讨论中提炼洞察，用于产品定位或营销文案。
